name: Crystal Business System Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1994, Sadhna Broadcast Ltd is in the business of broadcasting television channels, news, film, music, serials, etc.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Company is in the business of television channels, news, films, music, serial, and others programs and being a feature agency on a worldwide network having stringers, special correspondence, and representatives at different centers and other allied activities
Services Offered:[2]
a) Television Media: Company telecasts India's foremost socio-spiritual TV channel viz. Sadhna TV. This satellite channel brings social and spiritual leaders on a single platform, catering to contemporary and traditional viewers. Apart from this, company has added bouquet of channels in various genres of News, Entertainment and Movies
b) Advertising:
Company is a premier outdoor and print advertising house for advertising on various platforms such as outdoor hoardings, bus shelters, pole kiosks and roadways buses in Delhi NCR and other parts of the country. Various State and Central Government Departments and private organizations are using company's media for their publicity campaigns
c) Publication:
Sadhna Path is an exclusive Hindi monthly, equipped to set guidelines on various socio-cultural aspects, health related issues, and astrological studies
d) Technology:
Company provides broadcast equipment and technology integration through Outdoor Broadcast vans, portable Live uplink and downlink devices, procurement of cost-effective equipment, broadcast software solution, studio setups and media office infrastructure

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -13.1% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 2.22% over last 3 years.
Company's cost of borrowing seems high
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -9.67%
Working capital days have increased from 95.1 days to 154 days
